_comment: Development overlay for the Agent tab, the second embedded web-application slot.
This file no longer carries the shipped defaults. The address, the tab name, whether the tab
appears and which bridge permissions it holds are all fields on WebAppSlot::agent() in
src/slic3r/GUI/WebAppPanel.cpp, because this file is excluded from the installer and a
customer machine therefore has nothing to read. Two sources of truth for the same values is
how they drift, so there is now one, and it is the one that ships.
What is left here is what the slot does not carry. Read once, on the first run of a build
that has the tab, and then never again -- see WebAppPanel::ensure_seeded and the
agent_app_seeded key. To point the tab somewhere else on a development machine set
ORCA_AGENT_APP_URL, which wins over both the slot and this file and is never written back.
_extra_origins_comment: Additional https origins the tab may NAVIGATE to. Navigable is NOT trusted: the bridge
